usage: Refers to a secondary school, usually for students from around age 12 to 18.
Commonly used on its own or in phrases like "讀中學" and "返中學" when talking about school life.
More natural in everyday Cantonese than the formal written term "中等學校".
Can refer to the school itself or the stage of education, depending on context.
